headline: A MarketWatch writer spent an afternoon with two humanoid home robots to see whether a machine costing about 55,000 dollars can do housework such as loading a dishwasher.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: a hands-on test of home humanoid robots, but only the headline is available so no result is confirmed.
importance_line: Households that might one day buy a home robot are the readers it matters to, but the headline does not say how the robots did, so the result is unknown.
summary: MarketWatch reports on a writer's afternoon with two humanoid housekeeping robots, asking in its headline whether a robot costing more than 55,000 dollars can load the dishwasher.
